title: Lift per-agent budget and timeout caps in athena.toml
summary: Set the [budget] and [job_plan] values in athena.toml to the owner-directed values, with job_usd 60 so admission accepts them. The snapshot already holds most of the new values but has job_usd 50, so the remaining edit may be only job_usd. Values only; no keys and no config.rs change.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check the resulting values and the passing test, not the activity.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: owner lifts budgets so agents stop hitting caps; the audience is the Athena operator and the admission check.
Snapshot athena.toml already shows most target values and job_usd = 50.00, so the producer must verify each value and set job_usd to 60.00.
Code survey: not needed beyond crates/athena-data/src/config.rs, which is unchanged because only values change.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml [budget] has reader_usd 2.00, producer_usd 10.00, verifier_usd 5.00, job_usd 60.00, producer_timeout_s 5400, verifier_timeout_s 3600; checkable with git diff and Grep on athena.toml.
athena.toml [job_plan] has planner_usd 3.00, critic_usd 3.00, max_rounds 5; no other key, added or removed, differs from the base (git diff shows only value lines).
Only athena.toml changes; crates/athena-data/src/config.rs and other files are untouched (git status).
job_usd (60) is at least the sum of the stage caps (reader+producer+verifier+planner+critic = 23), so admission accepts it; checkable by arithmetic from the file.

out_of_scope: Changing other budget values such as reader_timeout_s or check_timeout_s
departures: Tiny values-only edit, so cheaper and faster than the reference, and likelier to pass.
hard_reason: It changes budget caps that gate agent spend and job admission.
